name: wo-support
cmd: GDP_ENGINE_DUMP=/tmp/wo.json GDP_INFER_TRACE=2 timeout -s KILL 90 bun research/protocols/run.ts --ms 60000 --only consensus_wo_decide --skip given,broken 2>/tmp/err.log; head -c 300 /dev/null; grep -E 'join (small instance|enumerated|exists)' /tmp/err.log | cut -c1-200; timeout -s KILL 330 bun research/protocols/engine/woprobe.ts /tmp/wo.json support 2>&1 | cut -c1-500
